hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if [ -n "$f" ] && printf '%s' "$f" | grep -qE '/frontend/.*\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|css|json|md)$'; then root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); bin="$root/frontend/node_modules/.bin/prettier"; [ -x "$bin" ] && "$bin" --write "$f"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
